angle.en: Every city has a life story: nearly three thousand years on one river bend
angle.zh-CN: 每座城市都有它的一生：一处河湾上的近三千年

risk_notes.en: 753 BC is the legendary date (keep 'according to legend'); Wikipedia is often unreachable: save pages into sources/; Wikipedia and Wikidata are one publisher, so the sack of 410 and 1871 are single-source unless a tier-1 page confirms them.
risk_notes.zh-CN: 公元前753年是传说年代（保留「相传」）；维基百科常无法直连，请存入 sources/；维基百科与 Wikidata 算同一发布方，410 年之劫和 1871 年定都在没有一级来源时都是单一来源。

risk_notes.en: Birth date is Julian 1037-01-08 (lunar Jingyou 3, month 12): watch calendar and 虚岁 ages; Crow Terrace case details vary by source.
